name: Ruzozuzalpamaz
location: Northern room of Crypt of Hearts II

abilities.name: Spit
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that deal moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Onslaught
abilities.description: Ruzozuzalpamaz releases streaks of lightning from itself as indicated by red circles. This attack does moderate shock damage and thus the tank should face the boss away from the party to reduce the chance of them being hit.

abilities.name: Creeping Storm
abilities.description: Ruzozuzalpamaz places a large AOE under a random player. This attack does high shock damage over time as indicated by a red circle. This AOE will move along with the player it is targeting, thus that player should lead the AOE away from the rest of the party by running a lap along the side of the room until it dissipates.

abilities.name: Chattering Web/Spider Bites
abilities.description: Ruzozuzalpamaz wraps a random player in a cocoon. This attack deals low shock damage on-hit then moderate poison damage over time. Other party members must go near the trapped player and press the synergy key to free them. This attack can also be escaped using Precognition.

abilities.name: Spider Swarm
abilities.description: Ruzozuzalpamaz summons many spiders to attack the party. They should be killed as soon as possible to simplify the fight.

dialogue.speaker: Ruzozuzalpamaz
dialogue.line: Watch your tone, mortal. Blade or no, only the Whisperer commands me.

dialogue.speaker: Ruzozuzalpamaz
dialogue.line: This is not a place for mortals.

dialogue.speaker: Ruzozuzalpamaz
dialogue.line: Let's see if you can keep up.

dialogue.speaker: Ruzozuzalpamaz
dialogue.line: You'll make a fine meal for my children.

dialogue.speaker: Ruzozuzalpamaz
dialogue.line: Give up. Let my web take you.

dialogue.speaker: Ruzozuzalpamaz
dialogue.line: What did you hope to accomplish by coming here? We will feast on your carcass, and thus, your carcass will make these grounds fertile.

dialogue.speaker: Ruzozuzalpamaz
dialogue.line: My web will hold your bodies for later.

summary: Ruzozuzalpamaz is a Spider Daedra found within the Crypt of Hearts II. She serves as the first boss the players have to defeat to progress. Her unique drop is Ruzozuzalpamaz's Charged Barb.
